newsitem.title: GREECE: CONVICTED PAN AM AIRLINER BOMBER LEAVES GREECE.
newsitem.headline: CONVICTED PAN AM AIRLINER BOMBER LEAVES GREECE.

text.p: A Palestinian guerrilla convicted for bombing a Pan American airliner and killing a teenager left Greece for Cairo on Thursday after being freed from prison early for good behaviour, police sources said.

Mohammad Rashid was convicted by a Greek court in 1992 and sentenced to 18 years in prison. He was jailed for premeditated murder in the mid-air bombing of a Pan American airliner in 1982 which killed a Japanese teenager and wounded 15 other passengers.
The United States reacted angrily to the court decision this week to free Rashid early for good behaviour, in accordance with Greek law.
"We believe that convicted terrorists should serve their (full) term," a U.S. embassy spokesman said on Wednesday. Washington had been expected to pressure Athens to reverse the court decision.

Rashid was arrested in 1988 on a U.S. tipoff. Greece refused to extradited him but agreed to put him on trial in Athens for the airliner bombing. It became a test case for Washington on Greece's commitment to fighting guerrilla activities. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
